name: The Abu Dhabi EDITION

address.street: Al Bateen Marina - Abu Dhabi - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: Where ultra-modern luxury meets traditional Emirati hospitality in the heart of the UAE's cultural capital.
whats_special: This stunning waterfront property features the signature EDITION aesthetic with minimalist design and cutting-edge amenities. Located on Al Bateen Marina, guests enjoy direct beach access and panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf. The hotel houses acclaimed dining venues including a rooftop bar and beachfront restaurant, plus a world-class spa and infinity pool overlooking the marina.
pro_tip: Book a marina-facing room for sunrise views and easy access to the hotel's private beach club. The rooftop bar offers the best sunset vistas in the city.
dont_miss: Explore nearby Cultural District on Saadiyat Island (15 minutes away) home to the Louvre Abu Dhabi and upcoming Guggenheim. The hotel's location provides quick access to Yas Island's Ferrari World and the iconic Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque, one of the world's largest mosques just 20 minutes away.
pros: Prime beachfront location on Saadiyat Island with pristine white sand beach access
Sophisticated Ian Schrager design aesthetic with modern luxury interiors
World-class dining venues including rooftop restaurant with panoramic city views
Comprehensive wellness facilities with spa, fitness center, and multiple pools
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Island location requires transfer to reach downtown Abu Dhabi attractions
